# vastdata_tenant_metric_labels (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "vastdata_tenant_metric_labels" "by_id" {
  id = 1
}

data "vastdata_tenant_metric_labels" "by_key" {
  key = "environment"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the metric label was created.
- `default_value` (String) The default value for this metric label.
- `description` (String) Description of the metric label purpose.
- `key` (String) The unique key for the metric label.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.
